references.text: Warns against forgetting the Lord after entering the promised land, the same theme of forgetting God that led the people out of Egypt.
Reminds that the Lord brought the people out of Egypt, from the house of bondage, the same expression as in Deuteronomy 8:14.
A fundamental statement that the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, from the house of bondage, using identical language.
Refers to the Lord who brought the people out of Egypt, from the house of bondage, with the same wording.
Hosea warns against the heart becoming proud and the people forgetting the Lord, parallel to the theme of pride and forgetfulness.
Ezekiel warns against the heart becoming proud, the same theme of an exalted heart that leads one away from God.
Proverbs warns against pride and arrogance that come before a fall, related to the warning about an exalted heart.
